audit_result.proof_trace: The Supabase query (L15-20) applies no `.limit()` or `.range()` call, fetching the entire non-deleted members table unconditionally. The result is mapped via `Promise.all(members.map(...))` with no concurrency cap, then returned in full — no `PAGINATION_LIMIT` is enforced anywhere on this path, so the assertion `response.data.length <= PAGINATION_LIMIT` is violated on every call.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker who obtains the shared `API_AUTH_TOKEN` (e.g., via env leak, Docker config, or git history) sends one GET /api/members request, receiving all member PII (discord_uid, student_number, generation) in a single unbounded response; additionally, the uncapped `Promise.all` over every member can exhaust Discord API rate limits and stall the bot.

PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-011.text: getAllMembers must not allow unbounded bulk enumeration of all member data.
